newsitem.title: UK: UK's EasyJet to take on 200 new staff.
newsitem.headline: UK's EasyJet to take on 200 new staff.

text.p: EasyJet, the low cost UK airline, said on Thursday it would create 200 jobs at its headquarters at Luton airport north of London over the next year, nearly doubling its workforce.
Most of the vacancies will be in the company's cabin crew and telesales departments, but there will also be 30 new jobs for pilots.
The telesales and cabin staff will be recruited locally as far as possible, maintaining EasyJet's record of taking 90 percent of staff from the local area.
The company, which has flown more than one million passengers since its launch in 1995, expects to be carrying two million passengers by the end of 1997.
It currently has five aircraft, with two more due to come into service by the end of the year.
